name: @pipeworx/mcp-tfl

tools.name: line_status
tools.description: Current service status for London transport lines. Pass either a comma-separated list of modes (e.g. "tube,dlr") OR a specific lineId (e.g. "victoria", "central"). Returns each line with lineStatuses + statusSeverityDescription (e.g. "Good Service", "Minor Delays").

modes.description: Comma-separated transport modes: tube, dlr, overground, elizabeth-line, bus, tram, national-rail. Used when lineId is not given.

lineId.description: Specific line id, e.g. "victoria", "central", "elizabeth". Takes precedence over modes.

tools.name: stop_search
tools.description: Search for stops/stations by name. Returns matches with a naptanId (the "id" field) used by the arrivals tool, plus modes, zone, and lat/lon.

query.description: Stop/station name to search for, e.g. "Oxford Circus".

modes.description: Optional filter. Comma-separated transport modes: tube, dlr, overground, elizabeth-line, bus, tram, national-rail.

tools.name: arrivals
tools.description: Real-time predicted arrivals at a stop. Pass the naptanId from stop_search (e.g. "940GZZLUOXC"). Results are sorted by timeToStation (seconds away), nearest first.

naptanId.description: Stop NaPTAN id, obtained from stop_search.

tools.name: plan_journey
tools.description: Plan a journey across London transport. from/to may be stop names, postcodes, or "lat,lon" coordinates. Returns journey options (legs, durations, modes). If a location is ambiguous, the API returns disambiguation options instead of journeys — refine the input or use a naptanId/coords.

tools.name: bike_points
tools.description: London Santander Cycle hire scheme — live pushbike and empty-dock counts at each London cycle-hire docking point (bikes available, spaces free, total capacity in additionalProperties). London public bicycle rental only. Pass an optional area filter, e.g. "Clerkenwell"; omit for all London cycle docks.

search.description: Optional name/area filter, e.g. "Clerkenwell". Omit for all docks.

tools.name: disruptions
tools.description: Current disruptions for the given transport modes, with description and affected lines.

modes.description: Comma-separated transport modes: tube, dlr, overground, elizabeth-line, bus, tram, national-rail. Defaults to "tube".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tfl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tfl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
